metadata.sourcePolicy: Values transcribed from uploaded PDFs; absent columns remain blank. Team totals are not combined across clubs or added to player ranking.
metadata.melbournePitchingSourceCaveat: The uploaded game-row pitching R fields sum to 8, which conflicts with the final score of 4 runs allowed; team standings use the official final score. Pitching ER/H/BB/SO/IP are provisionally transcribed from the supplied row format.
metadata.melbourneBattingSourceCaveat: Estimated OBP = (H + BB) / (AB + BB); missing historical HBP/SF/CI are not assumed to be known. OPS = estimated OBP + published SLG. These are estimates, not verified official OBP/OPS. All other player stats unchanged.
metadata.melbourneStatPolicy: Melbourne player and team stats refresh after verified game uploads. Opponent team stats refresh only when another advance scouting report is published.
metadata.melbourneOBPMethod: Estimated from cumulative H, BB, AB, with unknown historical HBP, SF, CI excluded. Formula (H+BB)/(AB+BB).
